planets.name: TOI-1011 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1011 with a 2.47-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1011 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1011. Its orbit and size follow Brinkman et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
